name: Boostly – Conversion & Sales Toolkit for WooCommerce
author: WebTend

sections.description:
Boostly is a modular WooCommerce conversion toolkit that boosts sales through 8 focused, independently togglable modules — Quick View, Sticky Add to Cart, Direct Checkout, Trust Badges, Free Shipping Bar, Sales Notifications, Stock Scarcity, and Recently Viewed Products.

Disabled modules load zero CSS or JavaScript. Your store stays fast — no dead weight.

Instead of installing 5–6 separate plugins, Boostly combines every essential WooCommerce conversion feature into one lightweight, performance-first toolkit. Each module is engineered to work independently — enable only what you need.

📖 Full Documentation | 🚀 Boostly Pro

⚡ 8 Conversion Modules — All Included Free

Quick View
Modal product preview with AJAX add-to-cart and full variable product support. Shoppers browse without leaving the shop page — fewer bounces, more conversions.

Sticky Add to Cart
Floating bar with product thumbnail, price, quantity selector, and ATC button — always visible as customers scroll. Works on both mobile and desktop.

Direct Checkout (Buy Now)
One-click Buy Now button that skips the cart and redirects straight to checkout. Reduce cart abandonment on high-intent product pages.

Free Shipping Progress Bar
Animated goal bar that motivates shoppers to add more items to unlock free shipping. Drives average order value (AOV) effortlessly.

Sales Notifications
Recent purchase popups powered by real orders, virtual entries, or a mixed mode. Social proof at the moment of decision.

Stock Scarcity Messages
Two-tier urgency messaging for low-stock and critical-stock states. Built-in conversion psychology — no configuration needed.

Recently Viewed Products
Horizontal carousel powered by localStorage — zero server overhead, instant recall for returning shoppers.

Trust Badges
12 payment and security badges rendered as inline SVGs below the Add to Cart button. No external CDN. No privacy risk.

🏆 Why Choose Boostly?

  • Modular architecture — Toggle each module on or off. Disabled modules add zero frontend overhead.
  • Lightweight by design — Vanilla JavaScript, scoped CSS, no frontend framework. Under 15 KB per module on average.
  • Performance-first asset loading — Scripts and styles load only on pages where a module actually renders.
  • WooCommerce-native — Built on WooCommerce hooks and template standards. Full HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) compatibility.
  • Variable product support — Quick View, Sticky ATC, and Direct Checkout all handle variable products with full variation selector support.
  • Translation-ready — Every string uses proper WordPress i18n functions. A .pot template is included for translators.
  • GDPR-friendly — Recently Viewed uses localStorage only, no server data. Sales Notifications supports virtual-only mode — no real customer data required.
  • No upsells inside the plugin — Boostly Free is a complete, fully functional plugin. Zero locked features inside the dashboard.

🆓 Free vs. Pro

All 8 modules above are fully functional in the free version with no feature gating. A separate Boostly Pro add-on (available at webtend.net) unlocks advanced modules, premium pre-built designs, advanced targeting rules, conversion analytics, and priority support.

The free plugin does not require Pro to work. Install it and start boosting conversions today.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins → Add New and search for “Boostly”.
  2. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  3. WooCommerce must be installed and active.
  4. Open Boostly from your WordPress admin menu.
  5. Enable the modules you want and configure each one individually from its settings tab.

Manual installation:
Upload the boostly-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/ and activate from the Plugins screen.
sections.faq:
Will Boostly slow down my WooCommerce store?

No. Only active modules load assets, and only on pages where they actually render. Disabled modules contribute zero CSS, zero JavaScript, and zero database queries to your page load.

Does Quick View work with variable products?

Yes. The Quick View modal displays full variation selectors with image swapping and AJAX add-to-cart — identical to the single product page experience.

Does Sticky Add to Cart work on mobile devices?

Yes. Mobile and desktop visibility are independently controlled per module. You can show the sticky bar on desktop only, mobile only, or both.

Are Trust Badges loaded from an external server or CDN?

No. All 12 SVG badges render inline, server-side. There are zero external requests and zero privacy implications.

Is Boostly GDPR-friendly?

Yes. Sales Notifications can run in virtual mode — no real customer data is ever displayed. Recently Viewed Products uses browser localStorage and never sends viewing history to a server.

Is Boostly compatible with WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes. Boostly declares full HPOS compatibility via the WooCommerce FeaturesUtil API.

Does Boostly work with block themes (FSE) and Gutenberg?

Yes. Boostly modules are injected via WooCommerce hooks and render correctly regardless of whether you use a classic theme or a block (FSE) theme.

How many modules can I enable at once?

All 8, if you want. Each module is fully independent — enabling all 8 will only load the assets those modules require, on the pages they render on.

Does the plugin store data in the database?

Yes — module settings are stored in the WordPress options table, one option per module. Boostly creates no custom database tables and adds no scheduled cron jobs by default.

Where can I get support?

Open a topic on the plugin support forum. For Pro users, priority email support is available at webtend.net.
sections.changelog:
1.1.1

  • Fix: “Tested up to” updated to WordPress 7.1
  • Fix: “Tested up to” header corrected to WordPress 6.8 (was incorrectly set to 7.0).
  • Fix: Trust Badges SVG output now uses wp_kses() with an explicit SVG allowlist — removes blanket phpcs:ignore.
  • Fix: Trust Badges admin settings — inline style colour values now wrapped with esc_attr().
  • Fix: Sales Notifications virtual/mixed mode now appends a “For demonstration purposes” disclosure label to each storefront popup, ensuring FTC guideline compliance.
  • Fix: Sales Notifications admin panel now displays a transparency notice when virtual or mixed data source is selected.
  • Fix: All remaining PHPCS WordPress.Security.EscapeOutput and NonceVerification flags resolved across admin views and module files.
  • Improvement: Sales Notifications frontend output now restricted to WooCommerce-relevant pages, reducing unnecessary HTML output on unrelated pages.
  • Improvement: Tags updated for better WP.org search discoverability.
  • Improvement: Changelog entries backfilled with specific descriptions.
  • New: Translation template (.pot file) added to languages/ folder — 302 translatable strings ready for GlotPress.

1.1.0

  • New: Redesigned admin dashboard with two-column module grid and dedicated sidebar layout.
  • New: “Go Pro” action link on the Plugins screen for one-click access to Boostly Pro.
  • New: Dashboard now shows plugin and WooCommerce version inline for faster support diagnostics.
  • Improvement: Sidebar branding refreshed — compact logo badge and Free version indicator.
  • Improvement: Removed promotional UI from module settings screens for a cleaner configuration experience.

1.0.3

  • Fix: Design settings tab in Quick View and Direct Checkout modules not saving colour picker values correctly on second save.
  • Fix: Module settings page incorrectly showing “Saved” confirmation when switching between General and Design tabs without saving.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • 8 modules: Quick View, Direct Checkout, Sticky Add to Cart, Free Shipping Bar, Sales Notifications, Stock Scarcity Messages, Recently Viewed Products, Trust Badges.
  • Full WooCommerce HPOS compatibility.
  • Translation-ready.
